original: ねえ、フィリアって\nスタン君の事が好きなの？
traducao: Hey, Philia...\nDo you have feelings for Stahn?

original: ア、アンジュさん！？\nいきなり何を……
traducao: L-Lady Ange!?\nWhat are you saying all of a sudden...?

original: 私とスタンさんは、そんなんじゃ……
traducao: Stahn and I aren't like that at all...

original: あら、そうなの？\n確かに、わたし達は聖職者だし\n恋愛はご法度だけど
traducao: Oh, really? True, we are clergy,\nso romance is forbidden for us,\nbut even so...

original: ……人を好きになる気持ちって\n誰にも止められないものね
traducao: ...Still, nobody can stop the heart\nfrom falling in love with someone.

original: アンジュさんにも\n好きな人が……？
traducao: Do you also have someone\nyou have feelings for, Lady Ange...?

original: ウフフ。\nさあ、どうかな？\nわたしは一般的な事実を言っただけ
traducao: Hehehe.\nWho can say?\nI was only stating a general truth.

original: とにかく、後悔だけはしない様にね。\n今っていう時間は、もう二度と\n戻って来ないんだから
traducao: At any rate, just don't have regrets.\nThis moment right now will never\ncome around again, after all.

original: 添い遂げる事だけが\n愛情ではないと思います……
traducao: I believe being together forever\nis not the only form of love...

original: それが……私の答え……
traducao: That is... my answer...

original: それから、そこの紫のつる草と\n白い花は毒草です。\n気を付けて下さい
traducao: Also, that purple vine and white flower\nover there are poisonous plants.\nPlease be careful.

original: よく知ってるなぁ
traducao: You sure know your stuff.

original: お姫様ってのは、そういうのも\n普通に勉強してるもんなのか？
traducao: Do princesses normally study\nthat sort of stuff too?

original: いえ……そういうわけじゃ……
traducao: No... it's not really like that...

original: ただ、わたしは本を読むのが\n好きなだけで……
traducao: It's just that I happen to enjoy\nreading books, is all...

original: では、少し持って帰りましょう
traducao: Then let us take some back with us.

original: ちょっと待てよ。\n毒草だぞ？
traducao: Hold on a second.\nThose are poisonous plants, you know!

original: ですが、毒性自体は\nそう高いものではありません
traducao: However, the toxicity itself\nis not particularly high.

original: それより、注視すべきは\nその紫のつる草の汁……
traducao: More importantly, what warrants attention\nis the sap of that purple vine...

original: 高い揮発性を有し、おまけに葉の部分は\n化学反応を促進させる触媒になります
traducao: It is highly volatile, and the leaves act\nas a catalyst for chemical reactions.

original: これがあれば、あの研究も……。\nウフフ……
traducao: With this, that research will finally...\nHehehe...

original: フィリアも植物に詳しいんですね
traducao: You know a lot about plants too, Philia.

original: そんな事…
traducao: Oh, hardly...

original: それに、私の場合は職業柄\n致し方なく……ですわ
traducao: Besides, in my case it is simply\nan occupational necessity...

original: そうなんですか……。\n大変なお仕事なんですね
traducao: Is that so...?\nThat must be quite demanding work.

original: いや、職業とは関係ないだろ……絶対
traducao: No, that has zero to do with your job...

original: 気のせいかもしれないけど……\n最近、ご飯のメニューが\nまた豪華になってない？
traducao: Might just be my imagination, but...\nHasn't our food menu gotten\neven more luxurious lately?

original: そうだね。\n順調にレシピが集まってて\nもう３０種類を超えたって聞いてるよ
traducao: Yeah! Recipes have been coming in,\nand I heard we've already collected\nover thirty different kinds!

original: ３０種類？
traducao: Thirty kinds!?

original: すっごーい！\nレストランが出来ちゃいそう！！
traducao: That's amazing!\nWe could open up a restaurant!!

original: この勢いだと、世界中のレシピを\n全部集められてしまいそうですね
traducao: At this pace, we might just gather\nevery recipe in the entire world.

original: というより、ここまできたら\nそれを目標に頑張ってみない？
traducao: Since we've made it this far, why not\nmake that our goal and go for it?

original: 今のわたし達だったら\n出来そうな気がするんだ
traducao: With the way we are right now,\nI feel like we could actually do it!

original: うん、イケるイケる！
traducao: Yeah, we can totally do it!

original: そうですね……\nそれもいいかもしれません
traducao: Indeed...\nThat might be a fine idea.

original: 美味しいご飯は、皆さんの事を\n元気にしてくれますから
traducao: Delicious meals bring energy\nand cheer to everyone, after all.

original: ふふ、二人ともすっかりその気だね
traducao: Hehe, you two are completely on board now.

original: コンプリートまであと一息。\nもう少し、頑張って集めてみようか？
traducao: Just a bit more to complete the set.\nShall we do our best to gather more?

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: あの……どうかされましたか？
traducao: Um... is something the matter?

original: 今日は元気がない様ですが……。\n何か、悩み事でも？
traducao: You seem down today...\nIs something troubling you?

original: ……ああ、フィリアさん……
traducao: ...Ah, Miss Philia...

original: 何て言うか、その……\n人間って難しいなと思って
traducao: How should I put it... I was just\nthinking people are complicated.

original: 難しい、というのは……？
traducao: Complicated, in what way...?

original: いや、実はこのギルドのメンバーで\n知り合いにすごく\nそっくりな奴がいるんです
traducao: Well, there's a member in this guild\nwho looks and acts just like someone\nI used to know.

original: 見た目も、中身も……\n本人なんじゃないかって\n疑っちまいたくなる程……
traducao: Their looks, their attitude...\nSo much that I almost suspect\nhe's the exact same guy...

original: 見た目も中身も、ですか？\n……そんな方が……
traducao: Both looks and personality?\n...To think someone like that exists...

original: だから、そいつといると\n別人だってわかってるのに、\n知り合いの事を重ねちまう
traducao: So when I'm around him, even though\nI know he's someone else, I keep\nprojecting that guy onto him.

original: で、無意識に絡んじまって傷付けたり\nそれに気付いて、自分でも\n勝手に落ち込んだり苛ついたり……
traducao: Then I butt in and end up hurting him,\nand realizing that makes me feel\ndepressed and frustrated with myself...

original: そうだったんですか……
traducao: Is that what happened...?

original: 相手の事、振り回しっ放しですよね……。\nどうして、もっと割り切れたり\n大人になれねえのかって……俺……
traducao: I just keep jerking him around...\nWhy can't I just be an adult\nand let things go...?

original: ロニさん。\n迷いもあなたの大切な本心です
traducao: Loni.\nEven conflict is a true part of you.

original: 無理に無くそうとしては\nあなた自身も傷付いてしまいますよ
traducao: If you force yourself to suppress it,\nyou will only end up hurting yourself.

original: ですから、ゆっくり……、\n時間を掛けて、向き合っていけば\nいいのではないでしょうか？
traducao: Therefore, take your time slowly...\nWouldn't it be best to face this\none step at a time?

original: その方とも、そして\nロニさん自身とも
traducao: Face both that person,\nand face yourself as well, Loni.

original: 大丈夫です。\n神は全てお許し下さいます
traducao: Do not worry.\nGod forgives all.

original: フィリアさんは、こっちの世界でも\nやっぱりフィリアさんなんだな……
traducao: Miss Philia, even in this world,\nyou really are Miss Philia...

original: はい？
traducao: Pardon?

original: ああ、いや、何でもないんです！\nただの独り言なんで。\nははは……
traducao: Ah, no, it's nothing!\nJust talking to myself.\nHahaha...

original: （……迷いも俺の大切な本心……か……）
traducao: (...My doubts are a part of me, huh...)

original: あのさ……フィリアって\nあまり視力が良くないのかな？
traducao: Um, say, Philia...\nIs your eyesight not very good?

original: はい？\n私の視力……ですか？
traducao: Pardon?\nMy eyesight...?

original: 確かに、あまり良くは\nありませんが……。\nそれが、何か……？
traducao: Indeed, it is not very good,\nto be sure...\nDid something happen...?

original: ああ、いや……別に\n大した事じゃないんだ
traducao: Ah, no...\nIt's really no big deal.

original: ただ、ちょっと\n聞いてみたくなっただけだよ
traducao: I just got curious\nand wanted to ask, is all.

original: ほら、僕はメガネをかけた事がないから。\nはは、ははは……
traducao: See, I've never worn glasses before.\nHaha, hahaha...

original: ……くすっ……。\nおかしなクレスさん
traducao: ...Hehe...\nHow silly of you, Cress.

original: （言えないよ……。\n　昨日の夜、植木とスタンを間違えて\n　話しかけてたなんて……）
traducao: (I can't tell her... That last night,\nshe mistook a potted plant for Stahn\nand started talking to it...)

original: フィー姉さん！\nちょっちメガネ貸してもらってもいい？
traducao: Big Sis Philia!\nCan I borrow your glasses for a sec?

original: え……そんな、困ります
traducao: Oh... please, that would be a problem.

original: いいからいいから〜！\n少し借りるだけだって∀
traducao: Come on, it's fine, it's fine~!\nJust for a little bit, okay? :)

original: そ、そんな事をして\nどうしようというんですか？
traducao: W-What do you intend to do\nwith them, anyway?

original: ん〜、レンズ越しに見える世界が\nどんなのか、興味あるんだよね〜。\nそんだけ？
traducao: Mmmh, I'm just curious what the world\nlooks like through those lenses~.\nThat's all, really!

original: そんな理由で……
traducao: For a reason like that...?

original: 隙ありっ！！
traducao: Caught ya off guard!!

original: あっ！？
traducao: Ah!?

original: やたー！\nフィー姉さんのメガネをゲット……！？
traducao: Woohoo!\nSnagged Big Sis Philia's glasses...!?

original: だから、ダメだと言ったんです……
traducao: That is why I told you no...

original: 視力の良い方に、このメガネは\n刺激が強過ぎます……
traducao: For someone with good eyesight,\nthese glasses are far too strong...

original: あ、ジューダスさん。\nこんにちは。\nいいお天気ですね
traducao: Ah, Mr. Judas.\nGood afternoon.\nLovely weather today, isn't it?

original: ……何だ。\nその手に持っているものは
traducao: ...What is that\nyou have in your hands?

original: あ……実は、皆さんへの差し入れに\nお料理を作って来たんです
traducao: Ah... I actually cooked some food\nas refreshments for everyone.

original: 良かったらジューダスさんも……
traducao: If you would like some too, Judas...

original: 遠慮しておく
traducao: I'll pass.

original: どうせまた、味見もしていない、\n試作品か何かなのだろう
traducao: No doubt it is yet another prototype\nthat you have not even tasted.

original: 僕は実験台にされる趣味はない
traducao: I have no desire to be your guinea pig.

original: え……どうして、\n試作品だとわかったんです？
traducao: Oh... How did you know\nit was an experimental dish?

original: そ、それは……別に……\n何となくだ
traducao: T-That is... for no reason...\nJust a hunch.

original: どうして、わかったんでしょう……
traducao: How could he have known...?
